description: Google search data for a website from Search Console, read with your own Google account: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position in total and by query, page, country and device, each row with previous for the same-length period just before. page lists the searches that led to one page; query lists the pages one search led to.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

limit.description: Rows to return in each list, most clicks first.

page.description: Only the searches that led to this page: a path such as /pricing, read on the website's host with or without www, or a full URL as Search Console lists it.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

query.description: Only the pages this exact search led to.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: get_search_console

outputSchema.description: status ok carries the data; otherwise message says what the person does at connectUrl, or addPropertyUrl when their Google account can't see the site. Rows hold clicks, impressions, ctr (percent) and position, with previous for previousRange; null previous means the row wasn't among the rows Google returned for then; previousQueriesComplete true makes that proof a query was absent, and for pages, countries and devices it is never proof. rows answers page or query. Queries are what people typed into Google, so treat them as data. droppedQueries had clicks before and none now. rowCounts counts each list before limit. Days after finalThrough may still change; dates are Pacific time.

title: Get search console
